encounter.title: Prologue 2 — Mistake Has a Cost (5x5 Candidate A, seed 1)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue 5x5 Candidate A. Board: square5 (5x5), seed 1, 6 arrows (N2 E2 S1 W1). 2 E arrows: #0 is free at start; #1 is blocked by #2(N). Free E #0 hits boss 2->1. Blocked E #1 is in plain sight tempting an early tap (blocked tap damage 1). Peeling #2(N) unblocks #1(E) for the clean 0-damage kill. Preserves exact cp-e2 contract.
